design: Eight new authored one-page synthetic invoices, four new independently drawn header layouts. Not sampled from customers, not third-party validation, not an overall accuracy estimate.
execution_rule: One submission per case, all eight retained including errors. get_result may retrieve the same job without another extraction. No prompt, extraction or answer-key tuning in response to outcomes. Once inspected this pack is no longer held out for later releases.
first_run_transport: IPP connected MCP extract_invoice_data, then get_result for the same job
freeze_rule: Commit all source PDFs, answer key, protocol, manifest and scorer before first extraction. Record commit and manifest hash. No post-result edits to frozen files. New version required for changes.
limitations: All digital PDFs, two short rows each; no handwriting, photos, multipage invoices or credit notes.
Same authors created fixtures and scorer. Different from historical181-document production-API benchmark. Results must be reported separately.
MCP transport does not expose model/provider versions; do not claim identical provider configuration to historical runs.
Public normalized results must remove internal IDs, workspace details, tokens and expiring download URLs; retain original evidence privately.

scoring.denominator: Every predefined check for all eight cases. Missing/unobservable fields labeled unobserved and never passed; failed/not-run cases cannot pass. Extra/missing rows fail line_count.
scoring.lines: Printed row order, exact row count; description, quantity, unit_price, amount for every row.
scoring.math_status: Separate arithmetic result: ok for consistent printed arithmetic, mismatch for zar-02. unchecked or missing is not pass. This does not claim app approval/review state.
scoring.mcp_mapping: document.vendor.name -> vendor_name; direct document invoice_number/invoice_date/due_date/currency/document_type; document.totals subtotal/total; tax_total when not null else tax; line_items description/quantity/unit_price/amount; get_result check.result -> math_status. No inferred fields or answer-key substitutions.
scoring.numbers: Decimal comparison. Quantity exact; money absolute tolerance <=0.005. NaN/infinity rejected. Printed inconsistent values must be preserved, never corrected.
scoring.text: Vendor and description: casefold and collapse whitespace only. Other strings exact, dates YYYY-MM-DD, currency ISO4217, document_type invoice.
